_comment: Board-formed concrete: cast-in-place concrete poured against rough-sawn timber boards, so the face keeps each board's imprint: vertical strips about 10 cm wide, their joints, the wood grain and knots, and the form-tie holes (ambientCG Concrete045, CC0; tagged concrete, industrial, modern, pattern; 200 x 200 cm, so meters_per_tile 2 and tag s1, from the source). The source does not say board-formed; the maps show it plainly. It is one substance carrying an imprint, not an assembly (D1). Opaque: a matte, porous solid. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): cracks (overlay 1, damage; Cracks01 draws a crazing network, the right shape for concrete), scratches, dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask. Not carried: the wet look and efflorescence the wish list also wants. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Concrete_BoardFormed_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.note: only the IOR and metalness are taken; colour and roughness are the scan's. The scan's mean linear albedo (about 0.65, 0.60, 0.46) is a light, warm concrete, lighter than the entry's 0.51 grey, and is left as scanned.
